card.name: Digit 2 after m or in numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, mostly the 2 in m² (body surface area) after a dose unit like mcg/m or mm. Also a leading digit inside a number or enzyme name, such as 250 or 2C9.

modes.label: Squared unit digit
modes.description: The superscript 2 or 3 after m or mm in per-area or volume measures.
modes.example: The recommended dose is 1250 mcg/m <<2>> intravenously once every 3 weeks

modes.label: Leading digit of a number or name
modes.description: A first digit that begins a number or a code, such as a tablet strength, road number or enzyme name.

card.plain: It marks the small 2 in m² (body surface area) in dose units, and sometimes a first digit in a number or code.
